Market today:
The market's reacting to a Democratic sweep in the midterms, which is hitting some tech and AI names hard. Investors are fleeing to safety, pushing Treasury yields down. This is a risk-off mood, especially for your concentrated tech book.

Your holdings:
Your leveraged positions SOXL (-67.47%) and MUU (-39.88%) are in deep trouble, with stops that are clearly not working. SMCI (-28.46%) and SMH (-18.52%) also need serious attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on how tech/AI reacts to the political shift and monitor Treasury yields for broader market sentiment. Re-evaluate all your "SELL" status stops.

Bottom line:
This is a critical time for risk management; prioritize protecting capital over chasing new gains.
plays: SOXL & MUU: Your stops on these leveraged positions are broken. Re-evaluate and adjust them immediately to prevent further catastrophic losses.
SPY & QQQ: Both are "SELL" status but above their stops. Consider trimming these to reduce broad market exposure and free up capital.
SQQQ: Given the tech sell-off, watch SQQQ for a potential long entry at 42.46-42.37 with a stop at 42.06, as a hedge or speculative play.
